title: Crawley Borough Council, Horsham District Council, Mole Valley District Council, Mid Sussex District Council Cleaning Services - AWARD
description:
Crawley Borough Council, Horsham District Council, Mole Valley District Council and Mid Sussex District Council (the Councils) invite tenders for the provision of Cleaning Services as set out in these documents.
      
      This Procurement will be divided into three (3) Lots. It is intended to appoint a single contractor for each lot, bidders are invited to submit a tender for single or multiple lots. The lots are structured as follows:
      
      Lot 1 - Office Cleaning and General Cleaning Services of free to access public facing areas such as toilet blocks, community centres within Crawley Borough, Horsham District and Mole Valley District.
      Lot 2 - General Cleaning services at The Capitol, and The Museum & Art Gallery, Horsham District Council, and Dorking Halls, Mole Valley District Council.
      Lot 3 - Office Cleaning and General Cleaning Services of free to access public facing areas such as toilet blocks, pavilions and community centres within Mid-Sussex District

title: MVDC RBC Stray Dog Collection Service - AWARD
description:
Mole Valley District Council and Runnymede Borough Council invites tenders for the provision of stray dog collection services as set out in these documents. 
      
      The Commencement Date for the delivery of the ​services​ is scheduled to be on 27th May 2025 for Mole Valley District Council and 1st April 2025 for Runnymede Borough Council (both at 00:00 hours).  Each Council will be awarding their own Contract for the provision of all services detailed within their own Specification. 
      
      For Mole Valley District Council, the Contract will be awarded for a time period until 31st March 2028, with an option to extend for a further 2-year period (made up of 2 individual 12 month periods) subject to performance and the absolute discretion of the Council.  Mole Valley District Council has an inter-authority agreement in place with Tandridge District Council. The services provided as part of this contract will service both Tandridge and Mole Valley District Council areas. 
       
      For Runnymede Borough Council, the Contract will be awarded for a period of 3 years until 31st March 2028, with an option to extend for a further 2-year period (made up of 2 individual 12 month periods) subject to performance and the absolute discretion of the Council.   
      
      The tender is split into three lots - Lot 1: Mole Valley and Tandridge District Councils - Lot 2: Runnymede Borough Council - Lot 3: All Councils. Tenderers can bid on lots 1, 2 or 3. The purpose of lot 3 is to investigate if there is any efficiencies for the councils sharing one provider and therefore if you are bidding for this lot, the expectation is that your bid will reflect this.

title: Mole Valley District Council - Resurfacing and Associated Works To Grove Road Public Car Park, Ashtead - AWARD
description:
Mole Valley District Council is inviting tenders for specified improvements and refurbishment works to Grove Road Public Car Park in Ashtead. The works are provisionally programmed for 4th October 2024 to 25th October 2024, the contractor is invited to submit a programme and drawings detailing how this can best be achieved. The works include, but not limited to:  general redecoration of previously painted surfaces, repainting of metal railings, resurfacing of car park, repairs to base layer and soft spots, existing drain repairs, new thermoplastic marking of car park areas, new signage and associated works.  Refer to specification for full details. All works to be conducted in areas specifically closed off in an active public car park or the whole car park closed throughout the works (preferred option)  dependant on contractors submitted programme, working method and Health & Safety plan. 
      
      Grove Road Car Park is situated in Grove Road Ashtead, Surrey which is off Ashtead High Street and is one of two central car parks in Ashtead with busy times throughout the day. The car park is mainly short stay with some permit holders under the control of the Council There are several drains and gullies across the car park with most drainage from the car park going the Thames Water surface Water system. There is considerable Thames Water fllor relive systems for the Ashtead Basin area constructed under the north East corner of the car park. There is also a control cabinet owned by Thames Water and a Power Networks sun station. Please not the electrical cable route from the sub-station to the Thames Water control cabinet that is shown on the Thames water drawing but not shown on the services searches.

The Contractor will be expected to deliver improvements to service delivery and value for money over the life of the contract.
